title: storyboard.create_storyboard_version input
description: Appends a storyboard version for an episode. Section 9.3 makes the script and the director plan FIELDS of the version rather than provenance, so both are required and both must belong to this episode.

episodeId.description: The episode this version belongs to.

scriptVersionId.description: The script version this board was built from.

directorPlanVersionId.description: The director plan version this board follows.

basedOnVersionId.description: The version this one revises, or empty for the first.

changeReason.description: Why this version exists, in one sentence.

items.description: The board's rows, one per shot, in shooting order. FR-070 requires every one of these fields per shot, and the ordinals are assigned from this array's order rather than supplied.

shotId.description: The script shot this row boards. It must belong to the version's script.

shotSize.description: The framing: CU, MCU, MS, WS and so on, as FR-070 requires.

cameraAngle.description: Where the camera is, such as eye level or high angle.

cameraMovement.description: How the camera moves: static, pan, dolly, and so on.

dialogueAudioSummary.description: The dialogue or narration this shot carries.

continuityNotes.description: What this shot must keep consistent with its neighbours.

firstFrameDescription.description: What the first frame shows, which is what a video model is given to start from.

videoMotionDescription.description: The motion a video model is asked to produce across the shot.

assetRefs.description: The assets this shot uses, by asset identifier and role. The codes check that each names an APPROVED version of the project.

usageRole.description: What the asset is used as, such as costume or location.
